commit_text:
Trim excess leading path separators

A URL with excess leading / (path-separator)s would cause urllib3 to
attempt to reparse the request-uri as a full URI with a host and port.
This bypasses that logic in ConnectionPool.urlopen by replacing these
leading /s with just a single /.

--- src/requests/adapters.py
+++ src/requests/adapters.py
@@ -392,0 +393,3 @@ class HTTPAdapter(BaseAdapter):
+        if url.startswith("//"):  # Don't confuse urllib3
+            url = f"/{url.lstrip('/')}"
+

--- tests/test_adapters.py
+++ tests/test_adapters.py
@@ -0,0 +1,8 @@
+import requests.adapters
+
+

+    a = requests.adapters.HTTPAdapter()
+    p = requests.Request(method="GET", url="http://127.0.0.1:10000//v:h").prepare()

Files: requests/models.py
Symbols: requests/models.py::Request, requests/models.py::Request.__init__
--- requests/models.py
+++ requests/models.py
@@ -74 +74,8 @@ class Request(object):
-        self.url = url
+        #: Accept objects that have string representations.
+        try:
+            self.url = unicode(url)
+        except NameError:
+            # We're on Python 3.
+            self.url = str(url)
+        except UnicodeDecodeError:
+            self.url = url
summary: The Request class now accepts any object with a string representation as a URL, rather than requiring a string. This change allows users to pass custom URL objects directly to the request constructor without manual conversion.

commit_text:
Add README to requests/packages

- Hopefully people will read this before making changes to vendored libraries
Files: requests/packages/README.rst
Symbols: 
--- requests/packages/README.rst
+++ requests/packages/README.rst
@@ -0,0 +1,8 @@
+If you are planning to submit a pull request to requests with any changes in 
+this library do not go any further. These are independent libraries which we 
+vendor into requests. Any changes necessary to these libraries must be made in 
+them and submitted as separate pull requests to those libraries.
+
+urllib3 pull requests go here: https://github.com/shazow/urllib3
+
+charade pull requests go here: https://github.com/sigmavirus24/charade
summary: This commit adds a README file to the requests/packages directory to clarify that vendored libraries like urllib3 and charade are independent projects. It instructs contributors to submit changes to those upstream repositories rather than directly modifying the vendored copies within the requests codebase.

commit_text:
cleanup of auth __eq__
Files: requests/auth.py
Symbols: requests/auth.py::HTTPBasicAuth, requests/auth.py::HTTPBasicAuth.__eq__, requests/auth.py::HTTPDigestAuth, requests/auth.py::HTTPDigestAuth.__eq__
--- requests/auth.py
+++ requests/auth.py
@@ -51,3 +51,4 @@ class HTTPBasicAuth(AuthBase):
-        if not isinstance(other, HTTPBasicAuth):
-            return NotImplemented
-        return self.username == other.username and self.password == other.password
+        return all([
+            self.username == getattr(other, 'username', None),
+            self.password == getattr(other, 'password', None)
+        ]
@@ -234,9 +235,4 @@ class HTTPDigestAuth(AuthBase):
-        if not isinstance(other, HTTPDigestAuth):
-            return NotImplemented
-        return self.username == other.username and \
-            self.password == other.password and \

summary: This commit simplifies the equality checks for HTTPBasicAuth and HTTPDigestAuth in requests/auth.py. It removes strict type checking, allowing these objects to be compared with any other object that has the same attributes.
